en.shortDescription: Open-source team chat with topics and threaded conversations
en.longDescription:
Zulip is an open-source team chat platform organized by topics for efficient asynchronous communication.

Includes PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, and Memcached. Set SETTING_EXTERNAL_HOST via SERVICE_FQDN_ZULIP and complete initial organization setup after first launch.

de.longDescription:
Zulip ist eine Open-Source-Team-Chat-Plattform, die nach Topics organisiert ist, für effiziente asynchrone Kommunikation.

Enthält PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ und Memcached. Setze SETTING_EXTERNAL_HOST über SERVICE_FQDN_ZULIP und schließe die anfängliche Organisations-Einrichtung nach dem ersten Start ab.

fr.shortDescription: Chat d'équipe open source avec sujets et conversations en fils
fr.longDescription:
Zulip est une plateforme de chat d'équipe open source organisée par sujets pour une communication asynchrone efficace.

Inclut PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ et Memcached. Définissez SETTING_EXTERNAL_HOST via SERVICE_FQDN_ZULIP et terminez la configuration initiale de l'organisation après le premier lancement.

pt.shortDescription: Chat de equipe open-source com tópicos e conversas em threads
pt.longDescription:
Zulip é uma plataforma de chat de equipe open-source organizada por tópicos para comunicação assíncrona eficiente.

Inclui PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ e Memcached. Defina SETTING_EXTERNAL_HOST via SERVICE_FQDN_ZULIP e conclua a configuração inicial da organização após o primeiro acesso.
